description: INV-1 ('founder wallet != ANY other instance's wallet. No sharing.') is enforced only by a 2-entry DENYLIST (record-earn.mjs:51-52: 0xa3cdd4... and 0x9b1ee988...). A denylist cannot satisfy 'any other instance's wallet': the founder can still be pointed at any shared/other wallet not in the two hardcoded entries — a future child wallet, a partner instance, or a copy-pasted shared address. There is no positive binding that the wallet equals the distinctly-generated founder wallet. Worse, FOUNDER_WALLET (line 44) overrides wallet.json (line 46) with no verification that it matches the generated founder wallet, so the loop can be silently re-pointed at a shared wallet via env. The invariant is structurally unenforceable as written.
fix: Replace the denylist with a positive identity check: pin the founder wallet to the address stored in FOUNDER_DIR/wallet.json (the generated, distinct one) and REQUIRE that the effective wallet === that pinned address, lowercased. If FOUNDER_WALLET is provided, it must equal the pinned wallet.json address or die. Keep the SHARED denylist as defense-in-depth, but the allowlist (== the generated founder wallet) is the real INV-1 guarantee.
